item.description:
🇮🇳 🚨 INDIA: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS LEAK OF NOIDA METRO RAIL CORPORATION HRMS EMPLOYEE LOGS

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to have leaked about 500 MB of HRMS (Human Resource Management System) logs from Noida Metro Rail Corporation (NMRC), the metro operator for Noida and Greater Noida in Uttar Pradesh and a joint venture of the Government of India and the Uttar Pradesh government.

The listed contents include:
* Full names, gender and dates of birth
* User IDs, employee codes, departments and email addresses
* IP addresses and device info
* Leave application records with approval status, timestamps and access logs

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Staff identities combined with IP, device and access-log data from an HR system give attackers a ready map for targeted phishing and credential attacks against a public transit operator. No records were reviewed, and NMRC had not confirmed an incident at the time of writing.

This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that NMRC was breached.

VIDEO | Delhi: Former India opener Virender Sehwag saw a reflection of his famed daredevilry in Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s batting and said the teenage phenomenon should focus on building a long career representing the country.

Sehwag, who has scored 17,253 international runs, has a vastly different career record from the 15-year-old Sooryavanshi, who has scored 246 runs in eight T20Is at a blistering strike rate of 186.

“Sooryavanshi is in his prime, and his thinking is somewhat similar to mine, that of hitting right from the first ball. 🚨 NEW DATA-LEAK PORTAL ADVERTISES MILITARY AND LAW-ENFORCEMENT RECORDS

A disclosure platform operating under the name “Organizational Disclosure” is advertising purported datasets associated with U.S. and Israeli military, police and government organizations.

The portal, displays searchable archive categories and record counts.

Among the advertised collections:

U.S. Army — 8,059 records
U.S. police — 9,310 records
FBI/CIA — 108 records
Israeli police — 38,765 records
Additional archives associated with public officials

An underground-forum advertisement dating to August 27, 2026, also linked the same domain to a collection of international military-related information offered for $10,000.

⚠️ Analyst Note:

These are claims made by the platform’s operators. The authenticity, sensitivity, provenance and recency of the advertised records have not been independently established.

The existence of an indexed dataset does not prove that a named government agency was breached.

The platform may contain a mixture of public records, previously circulated information and potentially nonpublic material.

The portal warrants further intelligence assessment, but its listings should not be treated as confirmed compromises.

Source: For subscribers only
